questions.question: The study of internal structures of organisms is called:
questions.explanation: Anatomy is the study of the internal structures of organisms, including tissues and organs. Morphology refers to the external structure of organisms. Physiology deals with functions and processes within living organisms. Ecology studies interactions between organisms and their environment.

questions.question: A meristem may be defined as the group of cells which-
options: Add to the bulk of the plants.
Divide continuously to give rise to new cells.
Elongate and add to the group of cells.
questions.explanation: Meristematic cells are characterized by continuous cell division.

hi.question: विभज्योतक को कोशिकाओं के समूह के रुप में परिभाषित किया जा सकता है जो-
options: पादप में भार उत्पन्न करता है।
लगातार विभाजित होकर नई कोशिकाएँ बनाता है।
दीर्घीकृत होकर कोशिका समूह से जुड़ते हैं।
hi.explanation: विभज्योतक कोशिकाओं की विशेषता निरंतर कोशिका विभाजन है।

questions.question: Meristem is made of...... cells
options: Cells with specific structure and function
questions.explanation: Meristem consists of undifferentiated, actively dividing cells.

questions.question: Meristematic tissues are composed of
options: Immature cells with power to divide.
questions.explanation: Meristematic tissues have undifferentiated, actively dividing cells.

questions.question: Growth in plants is largely restricted to specialised regions of active cell division called;
questions.explanation: Meristems are specialized regions of active cell division responsible for plant growth. They include apical, lateral, and intercalary meristems.

questions.question: Which type of cells are responsible for lateral growth and secondary growth in stems and roots?
questions.explanation: Meristematic cells are actively dividing cells responsible for both lateral growth (increase in diameter) and secondary growth (formation of secondary tissues) in stems and roots.

questions.question: Both apical meristem and intercalary meristem are __________ meristems.
questions.explanation: Both apical and intercalary meristems are primary as they contribute to the primary growth of the plant.

hi.question: शीर्षस्थ विभज्योतक और अंतर्वेशी विभज्योतक __________ विभज्योतक हैं।

questions.question: Meristem responsible for regenerating grazed part in grasses is:
questions.explanation: Intercalary meristem is found at the base of leaves and internodes in grasses. It helps in regenerating grazed parts by promoting elongation and regrowth after being cut or grazed by herbivores.

questions.question: {{A}}, {{B}} and {{C}} are lateral meristems that participate in secondary growth of dicots.
options: A= Intrafascicular cambium {B}= Interfascicular cambium {C}= Intercalary meristem
{A}= Apical bud {B}= Lateral bud {C}= Cork cambium
{A}= Primary phloem {B}= Primary xylem {C}= Secondary xylem
{A}= Intrafascicular cambium {B}= Interfascicular cambium {C}= Cork cambium
questions.explanation: Lateral meristems are responsible for secondary growth in dicots, increasing the girth of the plant. Intrafascicular cambium (A) is present within vascular bundles and contributes to secondary xylem and phloem formation. Interfascicular cambium (B) develops from medullary rays between vascular bundles and also contributes to secondary growth. Cork cambium (phellogen) (C) arises later and produces periderm (cork and phelloderm), replacing the epidermis for protection.
